categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and updates cmake/introspection.cmake to detect and pass MSVC flags for hardware-accelerated SHA-256.
categories.rationale: Enables hardware-accelerated SHA-256 compiler flags in CMake for MSVC builds, eliminating a significant hashing performance penalty on that platform. While sipsorcery reported a 5x to 10x speedup in benchmarks, official release binaries do not build with MSVC, making this worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Utils/log/libs' label and edits cryptographic primitive support files (src/crypto/sha256.cpp, src/compat/cpuid.h, and src/random.cpp).
categories.rationale: Implements MSVC intrinsics for CPU feature detection to hook into hardware-accelerated SHA-256 routines (SSE4.1, AVX2, and SHA-NI). Benchmark testing showed 5x to 10x faster hashing on supported Intel CPUs, but because it only affects MSVC builds and does not fix a bug or correctness issue in the primitives, it is deferrable.
